SoundPitchGatesControlDrag from an orange output to a blue input; click a plugged input to unplug it. Keyboard: Tab to a jack and press Enter, then Enter on the jack to connect it to. Delete unplugs.

Octave C3

Play with the mouse, or your computer keys: A W S E D F T G Y H U J K. Z and X change octave. Tap or slide along the keys to play, and − and + change octave. A USB MIDI keyboard works too once you allow MIDI: Chrome, Edge and Opera ask straight away, Firefox asks you to add a small site permission first, and Safari has no MIDI, so use the computer keys there.
